concerns.text: The Constitution Check table maps Principle II (Verified Accuracy) to FR‑001, which concerns data ingestion rather than citation verification. This mapping appears inconsistent with the constitution’s intent that verified URLs be cited and validated (Principle II). Adjust the mapping to reference appropriate FR/SC related to citation verification or remove the entry.

concerns.location: plan.md:Section IV. Single Source of Truth
concerns.text: The plan does not explicitly designate a Single Source of Truth artifact (e.g., `data/processed/unified_fatigue.csv`) as required by Principle I. Add a clear statement that this CSV is the SSoT for all downstream figures and tables.
